LightningComponentBundle.description: ARC-styled record list view — saved-view tabs, search, group-by, filter chips, and save/overwrite view. Forked from arcListView so ARC keeps its own styling independent of the Envelope wizard.

property.name: newRecordLabel
property.label: Primary Action Label
property.description: Label of the header button, e.g. Add Contact. Leave blank to hide it.

property.name: viewTabs
property.label: Tab Views
property.description: Tab strip contents. JSON array of {view,label,title,subtitle,action} for per-tab headings, or the short form apiName=Label,apiName=Label. Blank shows only this view plus views the user saves.

property.name: pillFields
property.label: Pill Columns
property.description: Comma-separated field API names shown as colour-coded pills, e.g. BillingState. Each distinct value gets its own tone.

property.name: defaultColumns
property.label: Default Columns
property.description: Ordered, comma-separated field API names to show by default, e.g. Name,Check__r.Name,Amount__c. Can name fields the list view's own Setup config doesn't carry at all. Blank leaves the view's own columns/order alone.

property.name: defaultListViewApiName
property.label: Default List View API Name
property.description: Usually All or All_Envelope__c depending on the object
